purpose: Turn source-supported assessment routes into an explicit human page-review queue without changing verification or publication state automatically.
eligibility: The route is a Promotion Readiness human-review candidate.
The route has source-supported factual review for load-bearing product claims.
The route evidence profile requires external review for those claims.
The page still requires explicit human page-level verification.
review_gates: Confirm the page scope matches the reviewed claims and does not imply broader product coverage than the evidence supports.
Check release-sensitive statements against the recorded product and release scope.
Separate documented SAP behavior from author heuristics, synthetic examples, and reasoned interpretation.
Check process ownership and integration boundaries for internal consistency with the graph.
Check diagnostic guidance for a clear first wrong decision, proof of cause, and proof of business completion.
Check that human and machine-readable routes tell the same story.
Check local links, source references, and terminology before any publication decision.
completion_rule: A reviewer may record that the page review is complete only after all review gates are checked. Completion does not automatically set verified:true, remove noindex, or change publication status.
priority_rule: Review core assessment routes first, then secondary source-supported routes. Priority reflects assessment value and cross-process reuse, not page age.
publication_boundary: Human review evidence and publication decisions remain separate. The queue generator and finding recorder never edit page frontmatter or indexing policy.
